description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

AI-Enabled Platform Engineering Focus

 

About EverOps

EverOps is the partner engineering teams wish they had but didn't know existed. We embed elite operators directly in our customers' teams to help them ship faster, reduce risk, and optimize cloud spend. We call them TechPods: forward-deployed, outcome-driven, backed by proven playbooks and AI-native workflows.

We sit in the sweet spot between strategy-only firms and staff-aug vendors. Not Big 4. Not bodies for hire. Operators who think big and deliver fast. Since 2012, companies like Coinbase, Snowflake, and Peloton have trusted us to scale platforms, cut waste, and modernize delivery.

We are an AWS Advanced Tier co-sell partner, and our go-to-market is increasingly AWS-led. Our thesis is sharp: make AI actually run in production on AWS, not in a slide deck. That is the work this role delivers.

EverOps has always been 100% remote. Our culture was built for a distributed team to thrive, and this role can be based anywhere in the United States.

 

The Challenge

EverOps is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who brings deep platform engineering expertise and an AI-native mindset to enterprise cloud infrastructure. This role lives at the intersection of traditional DevOps and the emerging AI platform layer—you’ll build and operate cloud-native platforms where AI/ML workloads are first-class citizens, integrate agentic tooling into delivery workflows, and help our clients operationalize AI capabilities within their existing infrastructure. You’ll manage projects autonomously, leverage strong communication and collaboration, and focus on client satisfaction and high availability.

 

The Mission

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at EverOps you will join our U.S.-Based Virtual Operating Center (your home office), working with a team of dynamic engineers to manage and evolve multiple customers’ production cloud environments. You’ll bring AI-native thinking to infrastructure automation—using AI-assisted development tools as standard delivery accelerators, designing platform patterns that support AI workloads alongside traditional services, and contributing to EverOps’ growing AI practice. Our existing team of engineers has a deep understanding of our customer environments and are eager to empower, ramp up, and mentor each new hire so that success is achieved.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and use automation tools effectively to operate, manage, and scale production and development environments quickly

  • Design and operate platform infrastructure that supports both traditional and AI/ML workloads—model serving endpoints, inference scaling, GPU-aware scheduling, and managed AI service integration

  • Build AI-augmented operational tooling including agentic runbook execution, AI-assisted incident triage, and intelligent alerting pipelines

  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as standard delivery accelerators across infrastructure and automation work

  • Integrate managed AI services (AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent) into client platform architectures, including vector store infrastructure and RAG-supporting patterns

  • Automate toil reduction using LLM-powered automation—generating IaC, synthesizing operational insights, and accelerating documentation workflows

  • Implement new tools and technologies as customer requirements evolve, with a focus on AI-readiness across the platform stack

  • Monitor environments while focusing on constant improvement, including observability for AI workloads (inference latency, model endpoint health, token throughput)

  • Support production workload migrations using blue-green and progressive delivery patterns

  • Contribute to multi-tenant Kubernetes platform operations and maintenance

  • Participate in regular customer and internal EverOps scrums

  • Contribute to internal AI practice development, client AI readiness assessments, and the evolution of EverOps’ agentic engineering methodology

 

You Have

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a DevOps, CloudOps, Platform, or Site Reliability Engineer

  • Hands-on experience and deep understanding of Linux

  • Strong hands-on professional experience with either Golang, Python, Ruby, Bash, Typescript, or Rust

  • Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Azure designing, building, and running highly-available cloud-native environments

  • Production experience with Amazon EKS including multi-tenant cluster architecture, namespace isolation, and RBAC models

  • Experience deploying or operating AI/ML infrastructure—model serving endpoints, inference APIs, GPU instances, or managed AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and agentic tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as applied to infrastructure and automation work

  • Understanding of vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, or LLM integration at the infrastructure level

  • Experience with ArgoCD for GitOps-driven deployments; federated ArgoCD experience a plus

  • Experience with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, including integration with Kubernetes (External Secrets Operator or similar)

  • Understanding of GitOps workflows, repository structures, and governance patterns

  • Understanding of current best practices and principles related to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform + Atlantis and/or CloudFormation)

  • Experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Spinnaker, etc.

  • Familiarity and/or experience with containerization using Docker and Kubernetes (K8s)

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus/Grafana

  • Experience with automation tools like Ansible, Chef, Packer, etc.

 

Extra Awesome

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, or Strands Agents SDK for building agentic AI workloads

  • Experience building agentic workflows or AI-powered internal tooling (automated triage, intelligent escalation, self-healing infrastructure)

  • AI safety and governance awareness—guardrails, content filtering, prompt injection mitigation, or responsible AI operationalization

  • Platform engineering for multi-tenant AI workloads including isolation, cost attribution, and inference resource management

  • Argo Rollouts or similar progressive delivery tooling (canary, blue-green deployments)

  • FinOps experience including cost allocation, tagging strategies, and compute optimization for AI/GPU workloads

  • Gaming infrastructure or high-MAU consumer platform experience

  • Atmos (Terraform wrapper) experience

  • Platform consolidation or migration program experience

  • NoSQL experience with Cassandra, MongoDB, or DynamoDB

  • Relational database experience with MySQL or Postgres

  • Industry certifications (AWS AIF-C01, AWS Solutions Architect, Red Hat, HashiCorp, Google Cloud, etc.)

  • Strong desire to learn new technologies

  • Experience in SaaS companies and startup environments

 

Benefits

  • 100% remote workplace – We’ve been remote since Day 1!

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Equity – If you display ownership of the work you’re doing you’ll become a true owner of the company

  • 401K with company contribution

  • Company sponsored healthcare

  • Competitive compensation

  • Opportunities to accelerate professional growth with access to training and certification programs
